3D and VR training simulators

Staff practise on expensive equipment or dangerous situations in a virtual setting first, so there are fewer accidents and breakdowns. An MVP in 10–16 weeks, from UZS 240 mln; the full version in 20–40 weeks.

What you get

Questions

What does “3D and VR training simulators” cost?
The MVP costs $20,000–45,000 (UZS 240–545 mln), the full version $50,000–150,000 (UZS 600–1,805 mln). The exact price depends on the integrations and the scope.
How long does “3D and VR training simulators” take?
The MVP takes 10–16 weeks, the full version 20–40 weeks.
What do we need to provide?
Who plays and why, brand materials, one person who makes the decisions.
